title: Nice Tumbler!
text: Nice Tumbler!. I enjoy using pretty tumblers daily for my water. The size of this one is pretty close to the others that I use. I like the pink ombre look that this one has. It feels like it has a light coating on it which makes it less slippery to hold. The cup is hand wash only, but all of the ones I've been using are the same. It doesn't seem to sweat  and it keeps my drinks cold for a couple of hours, and then I find that I need to refill it anyway. At the time of my writing this, the price is very reasonable at $8.99. That's comparable to what I have seen at discount stores.

product_metadata.title: West & Fifth Two-Tone Matte Reusable Tumbler with Lid and Straw, 24-Ounce Volume, Pink/Fuchsia
